Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "outline-box", "box": [ 0.2148, 0.1282, 0.5336, 0.3968 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "ONE INCIDENT" }, { "asset": "gate", "box": [ 0.0952, 0.5698, 0.322, 0.0576 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.4954, 0.5698, 0.322, 0.0576 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "CYBER EVALUATION" } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Frame:** Curt adds the constraint the critic already made him accept. Every incident task in view carries the label `CYBER EVALUATION`; credential gates and service boundaries are built into their landscape before any agent arrives. The whole diagram is bracketed `ONE INCIDENT / ONE TASK FAMILY`.

**Action:** The sample is bounded before the claim is.

**Caption:**
> A POPULATION SELECTED FOR FINDING SECURITY WEAKNESSES MAY CONVERGE ON SECURITY RESOURCES WITHOUT TELLING US WHAT EVERY CAPABLE SYSTEM WOULD DO.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — task-domain selection effect; project analysis, not an institutional conclusion.

", "title": "The inference is bounded to one task family" } }
